This anticipated-response-inhibition task supports NM reaction tier 2 only; there is no unpredictable go cue, response selection, latency/accuracy assessment, conditioning prescription or claimed universal transfer. entries.name: Straight-Leg Cartwheels
entries.basis: The fixed two-hand, straight split-leg cartwheel coordinates sequential hand and foot contacts through a lateral inversion: competent tier 3 coordination. Its brief two-hand loading and transient inversion support only tier 1 strength and tier 2 dynamic balance. Travel in one direction is not a change-of-direction agility drill. These are provisional NM task categories, not validated physiological cutoffs.
entries.trainingConditions: Practice only the exact demonstrated shape and support. Use brief clean attempts or short holds with deliberate recovery inside each 45-second opportunity. This is quality skill/range/power practice, not a sustained-to-fatigue endurance prescription; no duration-dependent endurance tier or unmeasured aerobic/speed tier is inferred. The opposite lead/side receives its own complete mirrored 45-second block.
entries.observedAction: One continuous wide shot: raised-arm standing entry, two successive palm supports, straight split legs through inversion, both feet land and torso rises. The following closer shot is excluded.

entries.name: One-Arm Cartwheels
entries.basis: Removing one hand changes the actual cartwheel support and timing. The fixed single-palm inverted rotation is provisionally tier 4 coordination and tier 3 dynamic balance, with tier 2 brief bodyweight support. This does not claim expert one-arm static hand balance. These are provisional NM task categories, not validated physiological cutoffs.

entries.name: Side Aerials

Coordinating the launch, split-leg rotation and landing is provisionally expert tier 5 in this specific acrobatic pattern; tier 3 explosive takeoff and tier 2 lower-limb force are separate lower claims. It is not an assessed reaction, sprint or change-of-direction task. These are provisional NM task categories, not validated physiological cutoffs.

entries.name: Straight-Leg Firefly Hold
entries.basis: The fixed full firefly balances on two palms with legs resting outside the upper arms and both knees straight. Its combined arm-balance, straight-leg compression range and entry pattern are provisionally tier 3 balance, flexibility and coordination; bent-arm bodyweight support is tier 2 strength. No straight-arm planche or harder lever is inferred. These are provisional NM task categories, not validated physiological cutoffs.

entries.name: Eight-Angle Hold

This fixed loaded asymmetric arm balance is provisionally tier 3 strength, balance and coordination, and tier 2 hip range. It is not the different tucked arm balance shown by rejected sources. These are provisional NM task categories, not validated physiological cutoffs.

entries.name: Freestanding Forearm Stand Hold
entries.basis: The exact freestanding forearm stand balances a complete vertical inversion without head or wall support. Its fixed larger forearm base is provisionally tier 4 balance, with tier 3 shoulder force and coordinated entry/exit. This is neither a headstand nor an expert one-palm handstand. These are provisional NM task categories, not validated physiological cutoffs.

entries.name: Floor 90-Degree Handstand Push-Ups
entries.basis: The complete floor 90-degree push-up lowers a straight-body free handstand to the bent-arm horizontal lever and presses back. That fixed full-lever press is provisionally tier 5 strength, with tier 4 inverted balance and multistage coordination. No parallettes, foot support, added load or ballistic power is inferred; possible light head contact is included in the floor restriction. These are provisional NM task categories, not validated physiological cutoffs.

entries.observedAction: One continuous side view on flat palms: full handstand, controlled lowering to a horizontal straight-body bent-arm planche, then press back to handstand. Entire feet, hands and body are visible; no handles, wall or foot support. The head passes very close to the floor, conservatively included as a possible transition contact.

entries.name: Kneeling Full Pigeon Hold
entries.basis: The exact kneeling full pigeon combines full hip/spinal extension with overhead heel contact and a supported deep kneeling backbend. This specific range is provisionally tier 4 flexibility. The supported low-force stretch is not an assessed muscular-endurance, balance or maximal-strength task; no individual-toe grip is required. These are provisional NM task categories, not validated physiological cutoffs.

entries.observedAction: The full Kapotasana shape has shins and knees down, palms holding whole heels, deep hip and spinal extension, head/forearms near the floor, followed by release and return to tall kneeling. The grip is on heels, not individual toes. No props or assistance.

entries.name: Feet-to-Head Handstand Scorpion Hold
entries.basis: The actual handstand scorpion reaches both feet to the head while supported on flat palms. That fixed extreme backbend is provisionally expert tier 5 flexibility in the demonstrated action; two-hand inverted balance and coordination remain tier 4 and shoulder force tier 3. It is not labelled a forearm scorpion or a one-arm balance. These are provisional NM task categories, not validated physiological cutoffs.

entries.observedAction: The complete palms-only handstand backbend stays fully framed. Knees bend until both feet reach the head, then feet lower into a floor bridge and the performer rises. No forearm support, wall, foot-grip or assistance. The held frame is the actual feet-to-head shape.

entries.name: Aztec Push-Ups
entries.basis: The complete Aztec repetition launches both palms and feet, folds into a straight-leg airborne pike, touches the toes, and returns to plank. This fixed explosive whole-body action is provisionally tier 5 power and tier 4 coordination; the underlying floor press is tier 2 strength. An ordinary airborne tuck or clap would not establish the same claim. These are provisional NM task categories, not validated physiological cutoffs.

entries.observedAction: A complete uncut normal-rate repetition starts and ends in high plank. Both feet and palms leave the floor; the straight-leg airborne pike includes the actual hand-to-toe touch before hands and feet return. Later zoomed/slow teaching footage is excluded.

entries.name: Superman Push-Ups
entries.basis: The demonstrated Superman push-up launches the entire body, reaches both arms fully forward in flight and catches the body on the palms. This fixed extended-flight push-up is provisionally tier 4 power, tier 3 coordination and tier 2 underlying pressing strength. No toe-touch, clap, longer flight or added load is inferred. These are provisional NM task categories, not validated physiological cutoffs.
